impact: Still unfixed in the current T-018 body. Criterion 1's in-place idempotent rerun with no ownership check makes silent overwrite of user-edited plugin copies the specified behavior; the CLI-mediated design plus SwiftBar's GUI launch environment reproduces the exact PATH failure the plan already documents for GUI-launched MCP clients, with no absolute-path requirement and no minimal-PATH test in the criteria. Re-spec: checksum/version-marked atomic updates that refuse or back up unknown/modified targets, and a validated absolute launcher path with a poisoned-PATH acceptance test on npm-global and nvm installs.
resolution: Fixed by the v0.2/v0.3 ticket re-spec applied 2026-08-02: T-018's installer is now ownership-aware (marker-verified in-place update only for spendbar-shipped copies; refuse/prompt + backup otherwise) and resolves SwiftBar's plugin directory without assuming a GUI-inherited PATH. The full verified requirements record is preserved in this issue's impact field.
title: T-018's SwiftBar installer can overwrite user-owned files and assumes a GUI-inherited PATH
